key_decisions.decision: Preserves God’s food and aroma imagery while unfolding the tightly packed offering terms into natural English.
Retains the two daily times, rendering between the evenings as twilight with the idiom noted.
Keeps per-lamb quantity, sacred location and shekar distinct from the explicit wine of verse 14; does not imply distilled spirits.
Retains the holy assembly and ordinary-work restriction, distinct from the broader ban in 29:7.
Keeps the closing seventh-day assembly and the same work restriction as the first day.
Unfolds the delayed drink-offering and soundness clauses while retaining the named daily accompaniments and closing the nested instruction.
